name: xyst-ai-assistant
description: Cross-platform local-first coding agent for Windows and Linux

scripts.lint: biome check --error-on-warnings src scripts tests gui vscode
scripts.format: biome format --write src scripts tests gui vscode
scripts.format:check: biome format src scripts tests gui vscode
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm check:licenses:desktop && node scripts/build-desktop-runtime.mjs && node scripts/build-desktop-icon.mjs && cargo build --manifest-path gui/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked && node scripts/package-sandbox-helper.mjs
scripts.build:desktop:windows-installer: pnpm check:licenses:desktop && node scripts/build-desktop-runtime.mjs && node scripts/build-desktop-icon.mjs && node scripts/package-sandbox-helper.mjs && pnpm exec tauri build --config gui/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json --bundles nsis --ci
scripts.build:desktop:linux: pnpm check:licenses:desktop && node scripts/build-desktop-runtime.mjs && node scripts/build-desktop-icon.mjs && pnpm exec tauri build --config gui/desktop/src-tauri/tauri.conf.json --bundles deb,appimage --ci
scripts.check:desktop: pnpm check:licenses:desktop && node scripts/build-desktop-runtime.mjs && cargo fmt --manifest-path gui/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo check --manifest-path gui/desktop/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --locked
